calendar.label: Chinese New Year 2027 Holiday (Spring Festival)
calendar.impact: Make-up workday on Sun Feb 14, 2027; Mon Feb 15, 2027 is a normal working Monday. Your Feb 15–Mar 23 window begins immediately after peak holiday closures and return-travel surges end.
calendar.source_label: State Council General Office (国办发明电〔2026〕10号)

calendar.label: Lantern Festival (Yuanxiao)
calendar.impact: Not a statutory holiday, but a signature evening for Yu Garden / Yuyuan lantern displays inside the Feb 15–22 stay.
calendar.source_label: Yu Garden Official Site (holiday hours by notice)

calendar.label: 240-Hour (10-Day) Visa-Free Transit (US Passport Holders)
calendar.impact: Eligible for 240-hour visa-free transit when transiting through an eligible port (Shanghai Pudong/Hongqiao) to a third country/region; a direct US–Shanghai–US round-trip requires a Chinese visa unless an onward third-country leg (e.g., HK/Macau/Tokyo/Seoul) is booked.

date_options.label: Option A — Preferred Arrival (Mon Feb 15 – Mon Feb 22, 2027 · 7 nights)
date_options.why: Hits preferred Feb 15–18 start, captures Lantern Festival (Sat Feb 20), and sits inside Peninsula's lower CNY 2,465/nt promo band (13.8% below Mar 8–23).
date_options.pros: Full live quotes verified across 11 bookable MICHELIN hotels (from $1,376.21 all-in at Andaz Xintiandi to $3,549 at Peninsula / $20,119.33 CNY direct).
date_options.watchout: Mon Feb 15: Yu Garden & Shanghai Museum People's Square & Da Vittorio & T'ang Court are closed Mondays — schedule Bund walk, Jin Xuan, or Shanghai Museum East (closed Tue).

date_options.label: Option B — Mid-Window 7-Night Stay (Mon Feb 22 – Mon Mar 1, 2027 · 7 nights)
date_options.why: Still inside Peninsula's lower CNY 2,465/nt direct-booking period (Feb 15–Mar 8) while moving 10+ days past Spring Festival.
date_options.pros: Same lower-season Peninsula rate (CNY 2,465/nt excl. tax/fee) with lighter post-Lantern Festival crowds.
date_options.watchout: MICHELIN Guide Hotels live inventory rolls open ~90 days out; re-check checkout totals as dates pass 90 days out.

date_options.label: Option C — Extended 10–14 Night Stay (Feb 15 – Feb 25 or Mar 1, 2027)
date_options.why: Your brief allows 1–2 weeks inside Feb 15–Mar 23; 10–14 nights lets you pair 7+ Michelin dinners with Shanghai Disneyland and a 12306 high-speed rail day trip to Suzhou/Hangzhou.
date_options.pros: Keeps all nights inside the lower Feb 15–Mar 8 Peninsula quote window.
date_options.watchout: March averages higher rainfall (~86–88 mm vs ~65 mm in Feb); verify multi-week hotel quotes directly.

booking_guidance.title: Industry Booking-Window Benchmarks (Not Hotel Guarantees)
booking_guidance.detail: Third-party industry analyses (Hotels.com / KAYAK) report 8–14 days pre-check-in often yields lowest average city rates, while Mews recommends 1–3 months ahead for balance of rate and category choice. Book a free-cancellation rate (e.g., Langham Feb 10 cutoff, Peninsula/Sukhothai/Shangri-La Feb 14 cutoff) and re-price before cancellation closes.

skeleton_7n.notes: Avoid Yu Garden, Shanghai Museum People's Square, Da Vittorio, and T'ang Court (all closed Mondays). Walk The Bund waterfront; dine at Yong Fu (daily 11:00–14:00, 17:00–21:00), Yi Long Court (daily), or Jin Xuan (daily).

skeleton_7n.focus: Old Town / Yu Garden + Bund Fine Dining
skeleton_7n.notes: Yu Garden opens Tue–Sun 09:00–16:30 (¥30/adult off-peak). Shanghai Museum East is closed Tuesdays — save East for Wed+. Evening: Canton Table (daily) or 8 ½ Otto e Mezzo Bombana (dinner Mon–Sun).
Shanghai Museum East open Wed–Mon 10:00–18:00 (free permanent galleries, bring passport). Pair with Museum of Art Pudong (daily 10:00–21:00) or Jin Xuan (53F Ritz-Carlton Pudong).

skeleton_7n.focus: People's Square / Power Station of Art + Tasting Menu
skeleton_7n.notes: Power Station of Art (Tue–Sun 11:00–19:00, Huangpu). 8 ½ Otto e Mezzo Bombana opens Thu–Sun lunch; Taian Table runs Tue–Sat dinner (18:00–20:00 seatings, ¥2,588/¥2,888 pp).

skeleton_7n.focus: China Art Museum / Jing'an & Xintiandi Dining
skeleton_7n.notes: China Art Museum (Tue–Sun 10:00–18:00, Pudong Line 8) or Jing'an luxury cluster (Bao Li Xuan 2★, Il Ristorante 1★).

skeleton_7n.focus: Lantern Festival Evening + T'ang Court / Da Vittorio
skeleton_7n.notes: Lantern Festival evening in Huangpu/Yuyuan (verify 2027 holiday evening notice on yugarden.com.cn). Lunch at T'ang Court (¥888 dim sum set for 2) or Da Vittorio (2★).

skeleton_7n.focus: Shanghai Disneyland or Suzhou Day Trip + Farewell Dinner
skeleton_7n.notes: Full-day Disneyland (Metro Line 11; check 2027 park calendar closer to date) or Rockbund/Fosun Foundation galleries, followed by Sir Elly's or Mr & Mrs Bund (Bund waterfront).
Check-out (included breakfast if staying at Langham or Peninsula/Bvlgari direct/selected rates).
